historical_lineage.successor_of: H3R v1.0 decisive attempt / implementation PROTOCOL_DEVIATION

forbidden_post_train_inputs: test labels or outcomes during representation extraction
hidden mechanism parameters not exposed by the environment contract
any test-derived model, threshold, seed, candidate, or noise selection signal

mechanism_contract.M_shared: Within each clean/noisy paired row, the environment-specific simulator mechanism and realized factual row are identical; no cross-ENV-1..4 mechanism identity is claimed.
mechanism_contract.G_shared: Environment-specific causal/dependency structure from the frozen generator/config is unchanged between clean and noisy pair members.
mechanism_contract.F_shared: Structural/outcome functions, label mapping, and factual latent/context realization are unchanged; noise is applied only after generate().
mechanism_contract.Theta_shared: Effective generator configuration, generator seed, structural/context/nuisance realization, task label, and split identity are fixed within each pair.
mechanism_contract.Delta_e_allowed: Bounded observation-channel perturbation eta only; no state, metadata, label, parameter, graph, or mechanism mutation.

shift_contract.shift_profile_expected: Bounded measurement corruption of numeric observation channels after factual simulator generation.
shift_contract.realized_shift_validator: Verify identical environment/seed/test row/metadata/label; no env.intervene or regeneration; train-derived numeric mask only; categorical observation values unchanged; normalized numeric-channel L_inf <= 0.10; frozen label-independent noise seed derivation; identical noisy observation across L0-L4.

split_contract.split_definition: (environment_id, generator_seed, generator-native split element); native element is row identity for ENV-1/2/4 and episode-derived row identity for ENV-3.
split_contract.split_support_train: generator-native train support for ENV-1..4 x seeds [223691,965182,537173,538839,124586]
split_contract.split_support_validation: generator-native val support for the same 20 cells; integrity/smoke only, no candidate pruning or threshold selection
split_contract.split_support_test: generator-native test support frozen by protocols/h3r/h3r_test_manifest_v1.1.json; 20 cells / 6039 clean rows

noise_contract.N_delta: {eta: max_j |eta_j|/s_j <= 0.10}, with s_j=max(std_train(X_j),1e-6) from candidate-independent raw clean train observations
noise_contract.q_eta: Independent per-numeric-channel Uniform[-0.10*s_j,+0.10*s_j], four deterministic replicates per frozen test row
variables_affected: all numeric observation channels only; numeric mask fit from clean train observations
noise_contract.categorical_channel_rule: Non-numeric/categorical channels are copied unchanged into every noisy replicate; test values cannot determine the numeric mask.
noise_contract.pairing_rule: same environment + generator seed + test row + noise replicate; identical clean/noisy observations across L0-L4
noise_contract.state_dependence: NONE; channel scale uses train-only statistics and each noise draw is independent of test state
noise_contract.mechanism_preservation_assumption: Observation noise is applied after factual generation and cannot mutate state, metadata, label, generator parameters, graph, or mechanism.

metrics.R_clean: mean 0/1 classification error on frozen clean test rows
metrics.R_noisy: mean 0/1 classification error after averaging four frozen observation-noise replicates per test row

metric_registry.aggregation_rule: mean 0/1 loss over frozen clean rows within cell
metric_registry.uncertainty_rule: candidate-minus-L0 paired cell effects use the frozen stratified bootstrap
metric_registry.acceptance_rule: used by retained clean-utility guard with epsilon_utility=0.02

metric_registry.aggregation_rule: mean four frozen noise-replicate losses per row, then mean rows within cell
metric_registry.uncertainty_rule: comparison-layer stratified paired bootstrap over environment x seed cell effects

metric_registry.aggregation_rule: per cell R_noisy-R_clean; candidate effect E_noise=DeltaR_noise(candidate)-DeltaR_noise(L0); equal-weight environment aggregation
metric_registry.uncertainty_rule: 10000 deterministic stratified paired bootstrap resamples, seed 20260909, Bonferroni-adjusted 98.75% CI
metric_registry.acceptance_rule: support requires adjusted CI upper bound for E_noise < -0.01

metric_registry.aggregation_rule: R_clean(candidate)-R_clean(L0) per cell; equal-weight environment aggregation
metric_registry.uncertainty_rule: same 10000-resample stratified paired bootstrap and 98.75% multiplicity-adjusted CI
metric_registry.acceptance_rule: support requires adjusted CI upper bound <= +0.02

utility_guard.acceptance_rule: candidate support requires multiplicity-adjusted CI upper bound <= 0.02; lower bound > 0.02 clearly falsifies retained clean utility

baseline.training_source: historical learner definition/hyperparameters from EXP-LRN-001; retrained on H3R clean train split for each environment x H3R seed

candidate_set.training_source: historical architecture/hyperparameter definitions from EXP-LRN-001; retrained on H3R clean train split for each environment x H3R seed
candidate_set.model_selection_dependency: candidate family and hyperparameters are locked before H3R test; validation is integrity/smoke only

evidence_contract.positivity_support: not required for the primary synthetic observation-noise risk estimand
evidence_contract.consistency_assumption: paired clean/noisy observations refer to the same factual simulator row
evidence_contract.interference_assumption: noise applied to one row does not alter any other row
evidence_contract.unmeasured_confounding_assumption: not applicable to frozen randomized synthetic observation noise

statistical_plan.ci_method: deterministic stratified paired bootstrap: resample 5 seed-level cell effects with replacement within each environment, compute environment means, then average four environments equally
statistical_plan.multiple_comparison_rule: Bonferroni familywise alpha 0.05 across four L1-L4 vs L0 primary contrasts; two-sided CI level 98.75%
statistical_plan.aggregation_mode: noise replicate -> row -> environment x seed cell -> equal-weight environment mean
statistical_plan.worst_case_rule: support veto if any environment mean E_noise(I,L0) > +0.02 or any realized-shift validator failure occurs

acceptance.support_rule: A candidate requires 20/20 valid cells; adjusted 98.75% CI upper bound E_noise< -0.01; adjusted CI upper bound clean-risk gap<=+0.02; worst-case veto passes. Global support if at least one candidate supports.
acceptance.falsification_rule: Candidate falsified if complete valid evidence has adjusted CI lower bound E_noise> -0.01 or adjusted CI lower bound clean-risk gap>+0.02. Global falsified only if all four candidates are falsified.
acceptance.inconclusive_rule: No candidate supports and at least one valid candidate comparison remains statistically unresolved around the frozen practical/utility margins.
acceptance.invalid_protocol_rule: Frozen mechanism/shift/test identity cannot be realized or the realized-shift validator shows the perturbation changed state, label, metadata, parameters, graph, or mechanism.
acceptance.protocol_deviation_rule: Any decisive execution that changes frozen seeds, support, candidates, baseline, noise contract, metrics, margins, statistical rule, stopping rule, or accesses test before authorized unlock is a protocol deviation.

claim_boundary.tested_scope: L1-L4 historical learner definitions retrained under H3R vs L0/PCA on ENV-1..4, five H3R seeds, frozen generator-native test support, delta=0.10 train-scale-normalized L_inf observation noise, four replicates, shared LR probe, and frozen multiplicity/utility rules.

provenance.runtime_manifest: NOT_EXECUTED; execution runtime manifest is required after explicit test unlock
